main_text.p: utilia terræ pondera, ventres pigri, stupidæ pecudes.
Quid ad hæc Monachi? studiose ferram reciprocant, ac Jesuitarum vitam, mores & doctrinam nigro theta notant.

1. Qui legerit hist. Societ. par. 2. (inquit Alphonsus de Vargas) obstupescet, scio, ad tantam Jesuitarum in mentiendo audaciam, cum ipsis etiam Societatis primoribus, qui summam virtutis ac fidei opinionem apud magnos Principes obtinent, adeo verecundia non sit de rebus in propatulo positis palam mentiri. p. 21.

2. Jesuitæ à Rege Catholico petierunt, ut novam Madriti Academiam conderet, eique dena aureorum millia annui vectigalis constitueret. Huic Societatis postulationi Universitates sive Academiæ Hispaniarum libello ad Regem missō, typisque descripto intercessere: in quo Jesuitas describunt, ut homines

page.notes: Printed text at bottom is partly irregular; "missō" and "hist." as printed (possibly "hist." for "Hist."). Some letters in the upper right area are faint show-through and were omitted.
